homeIntro: We have bred English Cocker Spaniels in Grosseto, Tuscany, since 2005. We plan only a few litters a year, so each dog and each family receives the time they need. Natascia runs the breeding home personally, with the help of her family.

homePuppyText: Puppies grow up with us until they join their new families, whom we always meet before a placement. Here you will find dates and colours of our litters.

homeFaqs.question: Where is Allevamento Cocker di Podere Montecorno?
homeFaqs.answer: In Grosseto, Tuscany, Italy. We welcome families from all over Italy and, where possible, from abroad. Every placement begins with a conversation and a visit to the breeding home.

homeFaqs.question: Is the breeding home recognised by ENCI?
homeFaqs.answer: Yes. We have bred English Cocker Spaniels since 2005, and the breeding home has been recognised by ENCI and FCI since 2010. All puppies come with an ENCI/FCI pedigree.

homeFaqs.question: What comes with an English Cocker Spaniel puppy?
homeFaqs.answer: An ENCI/FCI pedigree, vaccinations, microchip, deworming and parasite treatment. Natascia explains the documents and care to each family.

homeFaqs.question: At what age can a puppy join its new family?
homeFaqs.answer: After 60 days of age, and only after an introductory meeting at the breeding home. For international travel, puppies may need to be older.

homeFaqs.question: What colours are the English Cocker Spaniels at the breeding home?
homeFaqs.answer: Mostly orange and white. Litters also include white roan, golden, and black and white. The colours of each litter are listed on the Puppies page.

homeFaqs.question: How do I contact the breeding home?
homeFaqs.answer: Message Natascia on WhatsApp at +39 347 335 1061. We reply to messages only, not calls.
